$comment: Hand-edited source of truth for the Lattice clone's IA (updated from the code after T1-T17 landed). IA.md and matrix.csv are generated from this file by build.mjs. Section ids and template ids (T0-T17) are the design-repo's: every section has a design-repo contract. Routes are the clone's own paths from src/routes.js (original-site URLs are deliberately not recorded). Redirects are documented in README.md (the ia.json schema has no slot for non-rendering routes).

meta.title: Lattice clone: information architecture
meta.source: Clone project (fictional brand Lattice): src/routes.js, src/App.jsx, src/Layout.jsx, src/content/pages/*.js, src/components/**, design-repo/, specs/*.md, CLONE_SPEC.md
meta.status: all 18 templates implemented; sections re-derived from src/ and design-repo contracts

categories.SHELL: Site chrome rendered outside <main>: announcement strip, navigation, menus, footer, and the reduced navs that replace them on two one-off pages.
categories.HERO: The page-opening header block that holds the page's H1.
categories.SOCIAL_PROOF: Customer evidence: logos, quotes, customer stories, stat bands.
categories.FEATURES: Product and capability explanation: card grids, checklists, tabbed showcases, gradient panels, integration blocks.
categories.CONTENT: General text-and-media rows that are neither a feature grid nor proof: statements and media splits.
categories.CTA: Conversion blocks: gradient cards, closing bands, install prompts, and the dialog some hero buttons open.
categories.EDITORIAL: News, announcements and links out to resources or community content.
categories.INTERACTIVE: Disclosure and tab widgets whose main job is switching or expanding content (accordions and content-specific tab sets).
categories.LISTING: Collection and directory pages: listing headers, category navigation, filters, card grids.
categories.ARTICLE: Long-form reading blocks: article and story headers, prose chapters, side rails, breadcrumbs.
categories.COMPANY: Company and program blocks: people, open roles, compliance, certification programs.
categories.COMPARISON: Side-by-side comparison blocks: feature tables and maturity columns.
categories.COMMUNITY: Blocks unique to the dark-theme community champions page.
categories.EVENT: Blocks unique to the event microsite.
categories.DIRECTORY: Blocks of the statically mocked partner locator.

shell.announcement-bar.description: Rotating one-line announcement strip above the navigation: linked slides with previous/next arrows, autoplaying; hidden below 1024px. (runtime UI: retrieval-ineligible in the design-repo)
shell.announcement-bar.scope: 69 routes across the templates that list it (home, product-feature, solution, data-platform, industry, case-study-detail, content-hub-listing, filterable-card-grid, article, asset-landing, form-page, legal-prose, company-program, product-landing, pricing, champions).

shell.navbar.description: Sticky global navigation: brand mark, mega-menu triggers plus one plain link, search, secondary and primary CTAs and an account button on desktop; logo, search and hamburger below 1024px.
shell.navbar.scope: 69 routes across the templates that list it (home, product-feature, solution, data-platform, industry, case-study-detail, content-hub-listing, filterable-card-grid, article, asset-landing, form-page, legal-prose, company-program, product-landing, pricing, champions).

shell.mega-menu.description: Popover card opened from each navbar trigger: two groups of icon + title + description items, an optional featured item with thumbnail, a grey side column of links and a coloured footer strip. (runtime UI: retrieval-ineligible in the design-repo)
shell.mega-menu.scope: 69 routes across the templates that list it (home, product-feature, solution, data-platform, industry, case-study-detail, content-hub-listing, filterable-card-grid, article, asset-landing, form-page, legal-prose, company-program, product-landing, pricing, champions).

shell.mobile-drawer.description: Below 1024px: full-height drawer listing the menu categories with a drill-down sub-level and Back control, the plain link and account links, and a fixed bottom bar holding the two nav CTAs. (runtime UI: retrieval-ineligible in the design-repo)
shell.mobile-drawer.scope: 69 routes across the templates that list it (home, product-feature, solution, data-platform, industry, case-study-detail, content-hub-listing, filterable-card-grid, article, asset-landing, form-page, legal-prose, company-program, product-landing, pricing, champions).

shell.event-subnav.description: Chrome 'event' (route /summit): replaces the global announcement bar, navbar and mega-menu. Event logo lockup, two columns of links and a call-to-action; above 1024 an 80px sticky panel, below 1024 a fixed bar with a black burger and an instant dropdown.

shell.minimal-nav.description: Chrome 'none' (route /partner-directory): logo left and one 'Home' link right in a 64px static bar; no announcement bar, no mega-menu and no footer.

shell.footer.description: Dark footer: light brand mark, link columns (one link with a badge), newsletter block, region select, social icons, copyright with legal links and a cookie-preferences button.
shell.footer.scope: 69 routes across the templates that list it (home, product-feature, solution, data-platform, industry, case-study-detail, content-hub-listing, filterable-card-grid, article, asset-landing, form-page, legal-prose, company-program, product-landing, pricing, champions).

hero.center.description: Page-opening centred header: optional eyebrow, H1 (stacked lines allowed), lead, 1-2 large buttons, optional highlight row, and an optional image, poster or illustration below; brush stroke behind.
hero.center.scope: 30 routes across the templates that list it (home, solution, industry, company-program, product-landing).

hero.split.description: Two-column page header: H1, lead and one or two large buttons on the left, rounded image / video poster / illustration on the right (6/6 or 7/5), optional tag chip or product lockup above the H1; padded or flush-bottom; brush stroke behind.
hero.split.scope: 31 routes across the templates that list it (product-feature, data-platform, company-program, product-landing).

hero.champions-dark.description: Dark (ink-950) hero of the community-program page: program wordmark, H1, two dark buttons and a chamfered photo; five concentric chamfered outlines behind scale with scroll.

hero.event.description: White event hero tucked under the event nav: giant display H1, lead and one orange button, with two illustrated portraits at the sides (>=1024) or under the content as two tiles (<1024).

social-proof.logo-marquee.description: Infinite horizontal marquee of customer wordmarks that overlaps the bottom edge of the hero.

social-proof.logo-bar.description: Static 'trusted by' row: centred small heading above a single wrapping row of about six customer wordmarks; no motion (distinct from the homepage marquee).
social-proof.logo-bar.scope: 12 routes across the templates that list it (asset-landing, product-landing).

social-proof.customer-tabs.description: Heading and paragraph, a left-aligned tab row of customer names, and per tab a logo, headline, optional summary, button, a quote card and two stat cards.
social-proof.customer-tabs.scope: 26 routes across the templates that list it (product-feature, solution, data-platform, product-landing).

social-proof.quote-band.description: One bordered blur card holding a customer quote (icon, optional logo, 24/32 quote, attribution), or a 1-per-view slider of quotes; optional brush stroke or soft colour wash behind.
social-proof.quote-band.scope: 25 routes across the templates that list it (product-feature, solution, industry, product-landing).

social-proof.testimonial-slider.description: Header column (heading-2, body, optional button) beside a slider of quote or metric cards (logo, quote/metric, text link).
social-proof.testimonial-slider.scope: 15 routes across the templates that list it (home, industry, product-landing).

social-proof.stats-bento.description: Dark 'trusted at scale' band: optional eyebrow, heading, and four blur-dark cards in an alternating 7+5 / 5+7 bento, each with eyebrow, stat heading, body and an optional image or logo-tile row.
social-proof.stats-bento.scope: 29 routes across the templates that list it (solution, data-platform, industry, form-page, product-landing).

features.gradient-panel.description: Rounded gradient panel (grain overlay) with eyebrow, heading-3, body and a primary.dark button beside a product media image flush to the panel edge; alternates sides. The homepage and the assistant page use the same component.
features.gradient-panel.scope: 10 routes across the templates that list it (home, product-landing).

features.integration-tiles.description: Integrations block: eyebrow, heading-2, body and a button (5 cols) beside a 2-column grid of bordered platform tiles (logo + name) that link to platform or integration pages.
features.integration-tiles.scope: 10 routes across the templates that list it (home, product-landing).

features.integration-strip.description: Centred grey kicker and heading above a single wrapping row of square icon-only integration tiles and one button; tiles darken their border on hover.

features.card-grid.description: Section header (eyebrow, heading-2, paragraph, optional buttons or lockup) above a 3- or 4-column grid of feature cards (icon, image, stat, logo or bordered cards), light or dark, optionally washed or with a brush stroke behind.
features.card-grid.scope: 46 routes across the templates that list it (home, product-feature, solution, data-platform, industry, form-page, company-program, product-landing).

features.checklist.description: Icon checklist of capabilities/benefits: two columns of titled items, a split with an image, a before/after pair, or a 3-column grid.
features.checklist.scope: 24 routes across the templates that list it (solution, company-program, product-landing).

features.tabs-dark.description: Dark band: heading (+ optional paragraph) and a vertical tablist where the active tab expands its description, beside that tab's media in a blur-dark frame; brush stroke behind.
features.tabs-dark.scope: 20 routes across the templates that list it (product-feature, industry, product-landing).

features.tabs-light.description: Light centred tab row with an underline on the active tab; each tab shows a short description and one square image.

content.statement.description: Centred heading (+ paragraph) in an 832px column; T3 adds a diagram or a 16:9 video poster below. Homepage 'line' variant is a single heading-3 sentence.
content.statement.scope: 21 routes across the templates that list it (home, solution, data-platform, product-landing).

content.media-split.description: Two-column row: eyebrow, heading-2, 1-2 paragraphs (optional bullets) and buttons beside an image, diagram or video poster.
content.media-split.scope: 40 routes across the templates that list it (home, product-feature, solution, data-platform, asset-landing, company-program, product-landing).

cta.ide-card.description: One clickable gradient card: heading and paragraph beside a two-by-two grid of white tiles naming editor/install options.

cta.gradient-card.description: Mid-page conversion card on a warm gradient with grain: heading, paragraph, a dark primary button and an optional dark tertiary button.
cta.gradient-card.scope: 26 routes across the templates that list it (product-feature, solution, data-platform, product-landing).

cta.closing-band.description: Blue gradient-12 band with concentric circles: heading-2, paragraph, primary.dark + secondary.dark large buttons; optional right column with heading-4, paragraph and arrow link.
cta.closing-band.scope: 51 routes across the templates that list it (product-feature, solution, data-platform, case-study-detail, content-hub-listing, filterable-card-grid, article, company-program, product-landing).

cta.community-band.description: Long blue gradient band: eyebrow, heading, body, two dark buttons, and a right column of two or three stat blocks behind a hairline divider.
cta.community-band.scope: 18 routes across the templates that list it (home, solution, industry, content-hub-listing, article).

cta.dev-path-dialog.description: Modal that lets a visitor choose how to start: heading-2 and 3 rows (heading-4, paragraph, secondary button). Opened by any action with opensDialog (hero buttons on /product/lattice, /product/governance, /security, /product/integrations); the dialog takes focus, Escape and overlay-click close, focus returns to the trigger. (runtime UI: retrieval-ineligible in the design-repo)
cta.dev-path-dialog.scope: 19 routes across the templates that list it (company-program, product-landing).

cta.champions-closing.description: Half orange (#fe6703) and half white closing split: eyebrow, heading-2, body and a dark button on the orange half, a check-list on the white half with an orange corner triangle. Not a dark band.

editorial.news-band.description: Dark band with a co-brand lockup, one news headline and a read-more link.

editorial.dark-news-strip.description: Dark announcement strip (py 40): purple eyebrow, heading-3-styled h2 and paragraph beside a secondary.dark large button. No lockup.

editorial.resource-cards.description: Header (eyebrow, heading, optional paragraph) above two to four resource / story / post cards: 16:9 image link, optional tag chip, title link, optional paragraph or byline.
editorial.resource-cards.scope: 41 routes across the templates that list it (product-feature, solution, data-platform, industry, company-program, product-landing).

editorial.community-bento.description: Dark 'what is new' bento on #030711: spotlight card (text + square image), member quote card, next-meetup card, trending-topics card and photo-of-the-week card; idle brush stroke behind.

interactive.faq-accordion.description: Centred heading-2 and optional paragraph above independent accordion items (question 24/28.8, plus/minus glyph). Items open and close instantly with aria-expanded.
interactive.faq-accordion.scope: 20 routes across the templates that list it (company-program, product-landing, pricing).

interactive.course-tabs.description: Left column (eyebrow, heading-2, paragraph, primary button) beside flex-grow light tabs; the active panel lists course cards (16:9 image, tag chip + duration, heading-4, paragraph, chevron link).

interactive.photo-tabs.description: Header (eyebrow, heading-2, paragraph, primary button), six flex-grow light tabs and a 2-column mosaic of six square photos per tab.

interactive.install-tabs.description: 1036-column header (eyebrow or heading-2 + paragraph with inline links), two centred light tabs and a card holding a mono command row with a copy button.

interactive.persona-tabs.description: Three centred light tabs with 24px icons; each panel is two bordered cards (before / after chip, heading-4, 4-item bullet list).

listing.header.description: Page-opening header of a listing page: H1 with an optional eyebrow and lead. The opener of listing templates; classified LISTING, not HERO.
listing.header.scope: 7 routes across the templates that list it (content-hub-listing, filterable-card-grid).

listing.category-nav.description: Sticky (top 0, z 50) blurred bar: search field (3/12) and category pills (8/12, pushed right at >=1024); a 1px bottom border appears only while stuck (>=768). The search is inert, as on the source. (runtime UI: retrieval-ineligible in the design-repo)

article.guide-header.description: Page-opening header of a long guide: breadcrumb, optional tag, H1, author row or clock + read time, 1-2 large buttons (the first scrolls to the download form) and an image (r16) on the right.

article.story-header.description: Page-opening header of a customer story: customer logo, H1 styled heading-2, a stats row (24/32 bold values) and a bg-blur quote card (4 cols); brush stroke behind. Classified ARTICLE, not HERO.

form.form-header.description: Page-opening two-column header of a static (non-submitting) form page: left 6 cols with optional breadcrumb, tag, H1 and prose blocks; right 5 cols with the form card (sticky 32 from the top at >=1024) or a cover image. Forms validate locally and show a success paragraph; nothing is sent.
form.form-header.scope: 7 routes across the templates that list it (asset-landing, form-page).

legal.policy-header.description: Page-opening header of a policy page: centred heading-1 in 8 centred columns and an optional 18/28 last-updated line.

company.leadership-list.description: Centred heading-2 over a column of bordered cards (radius 16, shadow-lg): 242px avatar circle, heading-3 name, role, profile link and bio paragraphs.

company.people-grid.description: Centred heading-2 over a wrapped row of avatar circles with heading-4 name and role (250 max each).

company.role-list.description: Centred heading-2, a department filter (264-wide button list at >=1024, listbox dropdown below) and the roles grouped by department (tag chip, then title link + location + 'apply' button per role). Filtering swaps groups instantly.

company.compliance-rows.description: Centred heading-2 over rows of an audit badge (1/4) beside a heading-3 and prose with inline links (3/4).

company.program-list.description: Left half heading-2, paragraphs and a primary button; right half three items (24px icon, heading-4, paragraph, tertiary button).

comparison.journey-columns.description: Dark maturity columns: orange eyebrow, heading-2, paragraph, then three outlined columns (status badge or list of red x items) and a highlighted orange-outlined column with check items; a curve/dot overlay sits under the row at >=1024.

comparison.compare-table.description: Left heading-2 over a zebra table: empty corner, two centred heading-5 column heads, rows of a 16/24 500 feature name and value cells (violet check, info glyph + note, or empty).

comparison.plan-matrix.description: Heading-2, a sticky plan header (name, price summary, button per plan) and grouped feature tables (check, text or empty cells; info tooltips on feature names). Below 1024 two synced sliders show one plan at a time.

pricing.plan-cards.description: H1 (48/57.6 at every width), paragraph and four equal-height bordered plan cards: mono plan name, description, one-string price, allowances, full-width primary button and a check-list of features. No highlighted plan, no billing toggle.

pricing.add-ons.description: Heading-2 and an intro paragraph with an inline link above two translucent (white 70%, blur 24) add-on cards: heading-4, two paragraphs, three check rows and primary + secondary buttons.

community.about-band.description: Dark band: white heading-2 left, prose with white underlined links and two dark buttons right.

community.member-grid.description: Heading-2, paragraph and two buttons, then a 3-column grid of square-cornered member cards (chamfered portrait, heading-3 name, role, orange external link, text button with a plus icon). Cards lift 8px on hover.

event.photo-gallery.description: Endless horizontal loop of 14 event photos (two identical sets), 240x180 (305x229 from 768) with 12px (20px) gaps; never pauses.

event.recap.description: Black centred card: display heading-2, paragraph and an orange button; a decorative bar-and-hand glyph at the lower left (>=1024).

event.sponsor-logos.description: Display heading-2 and three bordered sponsor tiers (a labelled header cell, then wrapped fictional wordmarks), followed by a full-width outlined button. Fictional placeholder wordmarks only.

listing.event-grid.description: Single-select region dropdown (writes ?filter=) and a search field above a 3-column grid of event cards (16:9 image, region chip, title, date); a text no-results block replaces the grid.

event.closing-band.description: Black closing band: display heading (two lines) left, paragraph and an outlined button right (bottom-aligned).

community.story-slider.description: Eyebrow, heading-2 and paragraph above a draggable slider of 12 square-cornered story cards (16:9 image, type label, 24/33 title, byline, text button); arrows below. A slider, not a grid.

community.icon-cards.description: Heading-2 with optional eyebrow and paragraph above a row of borderless icon items (icon, heading-4, paragraph); light 5-column or dark 4-column.

listing.hub-grid.description: Stack of category blocks (gap 120): optional heading-3 + 'browse all' link, an optional featured row (16:9 image half + title half) and a 3-up card grid; may contain one inline gradient promo card.

article.progress-bar.description: Fixed top-of-viewport 6px track whose purple fill width follows the page scroll fraction. Rendered as the first child of the post page; no transition. (runtime UI: retrieval-ineligible in the design-repo)

directory.header.description: Page-opening header of the partner locator: centred 48/57.6 H1 and a paragraph in a 684 column. Classified DIRECTORY, not HERO.

listing.session-grid.description: Event dropdown and search above a 3-column grid of session cards (21 per page, View more adds 21); a filter or search change shows 3 pulsing skeleton cards for ~1.2s before the result.

listing.case-grid.description: Filters menu button + search field, a 3-column grid of 6 bordered case cards, a featured-story band (quote card over a brush stroke), 6 more cards and a View more button; a no-results state replaces the grid.

article.guide-body.description: Prose chapters (2/3, each opened by an h2) beside a sticky rail (1/4: table of contents with scroll-spy, then one promo). The report variant ends the prose with an embedded download form card. One DOM unit; decompose logically by chapter (h2).

article.story-body.description: Prose column (8 cols) of chapters, each opened by an h3, beside a bordered facts card (logo, labelled facts). Prose blocks: paragraphs, headings, lists, quotes, images, tables. One DOM unit; decompose logically by chapter (h3).

listing.press-grid.description: Centred heading-2, a 3-column grid of up to 21 press cards and a primary View more button (+21).

directory.partner-locator.description: Static mock of a partner locator: filter sidebar (collapsible facet groups with counts, selected-facet chips), search field, top and bottom pagination and a 3-column grid of partner cards (wordmark, name, url line, clamped text, tier badge). Filters AND across groups, OR inside a group; 9 cards per page.

listing.latest-posts.description: Heading-3 above three compact blog cards (16:9 image, tag + read time, title, author row).

article.post-body.description: One white section (py 64): breadcrumb, H1, author row and 'last edited' line, then prose chapters (each opened by an h2) in 8/12 columns beside a rail (3/12, 80 gap) of sticky promos and a sticky share bar. One DOM unit; decompose logically by chapter (h2).

event.photo-band.description: One full-container photo (object-cover, positioned 50% 74%), 560 tall (320 below 768). A single image, not a media block with text.

shell.event-footer.description: Chrome 'event': replaces the global footer. Giant event wordmark with a link block overlaid at >=768, a pixel-tile strip (dither, heat band, checker) and a citron tagline/copyright bar.

legal.policy-body.description: 832-wide centred prose column of heading-bounded parts (each h2 or h3 opens a chapter wrapper): headings, paragraphs with inline markup, lists, tables. One DOM unit; decompose logically by heading-bounded part.

community.dark-quote.description: One static 48/57.6 quote on #030711 with a 40px round avatar and attribution; nine stepped orange bars at the right (>=1024). A single quote, not a slider.

event.highlight-rows.description: Display heading-2 above a list of rows separated by black hairlines: a pixel icon, a display title and an outlined button per row. Rows, not cards.

event.quote-band.description: Black band with a purple pixel-dither strip on top, a display-size quote and mono name + role lines.

article.related-stories.description: Mono eyebrow, heading-2 and three bordered story cards (logo, heading-4 title link, summary, chevron link).
